# portal addresses per-company disclosures by: customer/Info2-N.aspx?UID=<id>
# (decisions 4.26). Source: TII K106 保險公司基本資料 (data.gov.tw 122361,
# openapi.tii.org.tw TableID=K106), head-office rows, retrieved 2026-09-05.
# Two Shin Kong ids exist and both are correct, which is the merger recorded
# in README section 4.5: 03458902 is the pre-2026 Shin Kong Life that was
# absorbed, 70789634 is the surviving entity (Prudential of Taiwan -> Taishin
# Life -> renamed Shin Kong Life on 2026-01-01). K106 predates the rename and
# still prints the old name against the surviving id, which is what confirms
# the chain rather than contradicting it.
# KGI is listed under 中國人壽, its name before the 2023 rebrand; same legal
# entity and same filing code 2823 (entities seed).
# The four smaller insurers below were added 2026-09-09 from the same K106 pull
# (openapi.tii.org.tw needs the TWCA intermediate in config/certs/ appended to
# the trust store, not substituted for it). They are here for one reason: each
# has a VERIFIED hedge notional in data/firm_hedge_panel.csv or
# data/firm_hedge_notional.csv and no denominator, so each is a numerator
# looking for its 國外投資. Bank Taiwan Life is the substantial one — thirteen
# reconciled periods from 2020-06 to 2026-06. Adding a row here is all that is
# needed for scripts/fetch_sources.py to pull that firm's Info2-1 page on the
# next relay run: firm_sources() reads this file directly.
